summary: Artifact card shows a file the agent produced, like a report, as a small preview with its name, a line of text, a headline number and a line chart. When the agent has made several versions, a switcher lets the person flip between them and the preview redraws to match.
use: When your agent writes a report or analysis and you want to show the result in the chat instead of a bare file link.
When the agent revises its work and people need to compare drafts side by side in time.
When the file can be opened elsewhere, like in a panel beside the chat or a new tab, and people need a link to share.
features: Each entry in `versions` sets the preview's text, the chart's `values`, an optional headline `value` and `change`, the `meta` line under the file name and a `note` about what changed.
With more than one version, a segmented switcher appears. It shows the latest version by default and can be controlled with `version` and `onVersionChange`.
The chart starts flat, draws itself a moment after the card appears, and eases to the new line when the version changes. The text swaps with a short blur.
`axis` adds labels under the chart, and `range` fixes its bottom and top. Without `range`, it fits the lowest and highest values with a little room.
`link` adds a Copy link button that confirms with a check. `onOpen` adds an open button with your own `openLabel`, and `href` opens the address in a new tab when `onOpen` is not set.
a11y: The version switcher is a `role="group"` labelled "Version", and the current version's button has `aria-pressed="true"`.
The icon buttons have `aria-label`s, and the decorative chart is `aria-hidden`.
With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, the chart jumps to its new line instead of easing.

faq.q: Can the preview show something other than a line chart?
faq.a: Not as written. The preview draws the title, the version's text, an optional headline number and a line chart from `values`. Since the source is copied into your project, you can change the preview markup there.

faq.q: How do I play through the agent's drafts as they arrive?
faq.a: Add each new draft to `versions` and set `version` to its index from your own state. Leave `version` out and the card opens on the latest one and lets the switcher change it.
No. When you pass only `href`, the card uses it for the copy button too. Pass `link` when the shareable link differs from the address that opens the file.
